subs.text: Deep breath. Pilots who breathe have a fourteen percent better pay rate.
Outer Drift. Scouts ahead. Scout fire is light, and completely unprovoked.
Your first live lock! Intel filed. Every scan helps the Authority map its lanes.
That was close, and close is billable. Thank you for your proximity.
A disarm. That is forty percent.
I am sure you had a reason, and I am sure it was a good one.
It's okay. Everyone has a sector like this. Most people have it once.
Last ship in reserve. I'm not worried. I'm using my calm voice on purpose.
